layers.meaning: Capital intentionally outside selected-count nominal deploy ratio: 65% for 1 name, 40% for 2, 15% for 3+.

Signal amount minus signal-side suggested-share notional at the observed trigger price; not fill cash.
Actual unsubmitted/unfilled/partially filled cash. UNKNOWN without order/fill evidence.
